step1.title: Start with company info
step1.description: Add your business registration, tax ID and contact details. These appear on every invoice you issue.

step2.title: Add your first branch
step2.description: A branch is a physical food court location. You need at least one before you can place units or tenants.

step3.title: Lay out the floor plan
step3.description: Draw the unit grid for each branch. Tenants will be placed onto these units later.

step4.title: Bring in tenant restaurants
step4.description: Connect existing restaurants or invite new ones to operate inside your food court.

step5.title: Replay anytime
step5.description: Use the 'Show me around' button in the header whenever you want to see this tour again.

step1.title: Start with company info
step1.description: Add your business registration, tax ID and contact details. They appear on every invoice and receipt.

step2.title: Create menu categories
step2.description: Organize your menu into categories like Mains, Sides and Drinks. Categories also route orders to kitchen stations.

step3.title: Add menu items
step3.description: Register at least one item per category to start taking orders. You can add prices, options and recipes later.

step4.title: Configure payment & operations
step4.description: Enable payment methods (cash, card, QR), set operating hours and currency to start serving real customers.

step5.title: Replay anytime
step5.description: Use 'Show me around' in the header to see this tour again whenever you need a refresher.

step1.title: Start with brand company info
step1.description: Add your brand's business registration, tax ID and contact details. They appear on franchisee invoices.

step2.title: Link restaurants to your brand
step2.description: Each franchisee location must be connected to your brand to share recipes, ingredients and products.

step3.title: Define brand ingredients
step3.description: Set up the master list of ingredients used across all your recipes. Costs and stock are tracked per restaurant.

step4.title: Add brand products
step4.description: Register the menu items your brand offers. Linked restaurants pull from this catalog automatically.

step1.title: Manage your restaurants
step1.description: Register restaurants, assign admins and choose subscription plans here. You can compare them side by side once you have more than one.

step1.title: Set platform company info
step1.description: Configure the platform operator's business details. They appear on subscription invoices sent to customers.

step2.title: Configure SMTP & email
step2.description: Set up the outbound email server so notifications, invoices and receipts can be delivered.

step3.title: Create subscription plan templates
step3.description: Define the plans customers can subscribe to. Each plan controls modules, limits and pricing.

step4.title: Enable a payment channel
step4.description: Turn on at least one payment channel (Stripe, bank transfer) so customers can pay subscription invoices.

step1.title: Set company info
step1.description: Add your supplier company's business registration, tax ID and contact details. They appear on every trade invoice.

step2.title: Build your product catalog
step2.description: Register the products you sell with prices, units and minimum order quantities. Buyers see this catalog when placing orders.

step3.title: Process incoming purchase orders
step3.description: Buyers send POs from the catalog. Confirm, dispatch and invoice them from the orders page.

step4.title: Manage buyer accounts
step4.description: View who is buying from you, set credit limits and payment terms per buyer.
